name: Obstructive, Restrictive and Vascular Lung Diseases

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Productive cough 3 months in 2 years defines chronic bronchitis clinically
Alpha 1 antitrypsin deficiency causes lower lobe panacinar emphysema
Honeycombing with basal subpleural fibrosis means usual interstitial pneumonia pattern
Plexiform lesions mark severe idiopathic pulmonary arterial hypertension
reference.pathophysiology: Smoke and inherited antiprotease lack let neutrophil elastase digest alveolar walls, while bronchial inflammation and hyperreactivity narrow conducting airways. Fibrosing diseases deposit collagen in interstitium through repeated alveolar injury. Pulmonary vascular remodelling raises resistance until the thin walled right ventricle dilates and fails.
additionalInvestigations: Alpha 1 antitrypsin level in early or basal emphysema
